paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance comparison of different methods in terms of Recall@50 and NDCG@50. The x-axis represents an unlabeled metric with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with integer ticks at each unit interval. The left y-axis denotes Recall@50 with a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, with tick intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis indicates NDCG@50 with a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.35, also with tick intervals of 0.05. A solid green line with circular markers represents "Recall@50 (Ours)" and shows an upward trend from approximately 0.37 at x=1 to about 0.54 at x=5. A green dashed line without markers represents "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" and remains constant at approximately 0.33 across the x-axis. The solid blue line with square markers represents "NDCG@50 (Ours)" and rises from roughly 0.21 at x=1 to about 0.26 at x=5. A blue dashed line without markers represents "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" and remains constant at approximately 0.14 across the x-axis. A legend positioned near the top-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding model information, marker shape and color.
